```{r outils, include=FALSE}
valeur = function(x) {
  x = as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x)] = ""
  x
}
tableau = function(d) {
  if (is.null(d) || !nrow(d)) return("Aucune information renseignée.\n\n")
  d[] = lapply(d, valeur)
  paste0(knitr::kable(d, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE,
                      longtable = TRUE, escape = TRUE, row.names = FALSE), "\n\n")
}
```

```{r surlignage, include=FALSE}
mettre_en_gras = function(x, terme, actif) {
  x = valeur(x)[1]
  if (!isTRUE(actif) || length(terme) != 1L || is.na(terme) || !nzchar(terme)) return(x)
  pos = gregexpr(tolower(terme), tolower(x), fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
  if (pos[1L] == -1L) return(x)
  tailles = attr(pos, "match.length")
  morceaux = character()
  debut = 1L
  for (j in seq_along(pos)) {
    if (pos[j] > debut) morceaux = c(morceaux, substr(x, debut, pos[j] - 1L))
    morceaux = c(morceaux, paste0("**", substr(x, pos[j], pos[j] + tailles[j] - 1L), "**"))
    debut = pos[j] + tailles[j]
  }
  if (debut <= nchar(x)) morceaux = c(morceaux, substr(x, debut, nchar(x)))
  paste(morceaux, collapse = "")
}
```

```{r latex_extrait, include=FALSE}
latex_echapper = function(x) {
  caracteres = strsplit(x, "", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
  substitutions = c("\\" = "\\textbackslash{}", "{" = "\\{", "}" = "\\}",
    "#" = "\\#", "$" = "\\$", "%" = "\\%", "&" = "\\&",
    "_" = "\\_", "^" = "\\textasciicircum{}", "~" = "\\textasciitilde{}")
  paste0(ifelse(caracteres %in% names(substitutions), substitutions[caracteres], caracteres), collapse = "")
}
latex_surligner = function(x, terme, actif) {
  if (!isTRUE(actif) || !nzchar(terme)) return(latex_echapper(x))
  pos = gregexpr(tolower(terme), tolower(x), fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
  if (pos[1L] == -1L) return(latex_echapper(x))
  tailles = attr(pos, "match.length")
  morceaux = character(); debut = 1L
  for (j in seq_along(pos)) {
    if (pos[j] > debut) morceaux = c(morceaux, latex_echapper(substr(x, debut, pos[j] - 1L)))
    morceaux = c(morceaux, paste0("\\textbf{", latex_echapper(substr(x, pos[j], pos[j] + tailles[j] - 1L)), "}"))
    debut = pos[j] + tailles[j]
  }
  if (debut <= nchar(x)) morceaux = c(morceaux, latex_echapper(substr(x, debut, nchar(x))))
  paste0(morceaux, collapse = "")
}
```

```{r contenu, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
d = params$donnees
cat("**Expression recherchée :** ", d$sujet, "\n\n", sep = "")
if (identical(d$type, "documents")) {
  cat("**Résultats :** ", nrow(d$lignes), " documents, ",
      length(unique(d$lignes$source)), " sources.\n\n", sep = "")
  if (length(d$absentes)) cat("**Sources non importées :** ", paste(d$absentes, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
  if (!nrow(d$lignes)) cat("Aucun document trouvé dans les sources interrogées.\n\n")
  # Les lignes sont des lignes de lecture reconstituees apres nettoyage HTML.
  extrait = function(texte, terme, marge = 3L, largeur = 95L) {
    texte = gsub("[[:space:]]+", " ", valeur(texte)[1])
    texte = trimws(texte)
    if (!nzchar(texte)) return("")
    mots = strsplit(texte, " ", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    lignes = character()
    courant = ""
    for (mot in mots) {
      candidat = if (nzchar(courant)) paste(courant, mot) else mot
      if (nchar(candidat, type = "width") > largeur && nzchar(courant)) {
        lignes = c(lignes, courant)
        courant = mot
      } else courant = candidat
    }
    lignes = c(lignes, courant)
    correspond = which(grepl(tolower(terme), tolower(lignes), fixed = TRUE))
    if (!length(correspond)) return(paste(head(lignes, 7L), collapse = "\n"))
    indices = sort(unique(unlist(lapply(correspond, function(i)
      seq.int(max(1L, i - marge), min(length(lignes), i + marge))))))
    blocs = split(indices, cumsum(c(TRUE, diff(indices) > 1L)))
    paste(vapply(blocs, function(z) paste(lignes[z], collapse = "\n"), character(1)),
          collapse = "\n[…]\n")
  }
  url_debat_an = function(date, numero, session) {
    jour = as.Date(date)
    if (is.na(jour) || !numero %in% c("1", "2", "3", "4")) return("")
    jours = c("dimanche", "lundi", "mardi", "mercredi", "jeudi", "vendredi", "samedi")
    mois = c("janvier", "fevrier", "mars", "avril", "mai", "juin", "juillet",
             "aout", "septembre", "octobre", "novembre", "decembre")
    rang = c("premiere", "deuxieme", "troisieme", "quatrieme")[as.integer(numero)]
    debut = regmatches(session, regexpr("[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4}", session))
    if (!length(debut) || !nzchar(debut)) return("")
    nature = if (grepl("extraordinaire", session, ignore.case = TRUE)) "extraordinaire" else
      if (grepl("ordinaire", session, ignore.case = TRUE)) "ordinaire" else ""
    if (!nzchar(nature)) return("")
    paste0("https://www.assemblee-nationale.fr/dyn/17/comptes-rendus/seance/",
      "session-", nature, "-de-", debut, "/", rang, "-seance-du-",
      jours[as.POSIXlt(jour)$wday + 1L], "-", format(jour, "%d"), "-",
      mois[as.integer(format(jour, "%m"))], "-", format(jour, "%Y"))
  }
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(d$lignes))) {
    x = d$lignes[i, , drop = FALSE]
    source = valeur(x$source)[1]
    type = valeur(x$type_document)[1]
    id = valeur(x$identifiant)[1]
    titre = valeur(x$titre)[1]
    date = substr(valeur(x$date)[1], 1L, 10L)
    libelles = c(ameli = "Sénat — Amendement", amendements_an = "Assemblée nationale — Amendement",
      questions_senat = "Sénat — Question", questions_an = "Assemblée nationale — Question",
      debats_an = "Assemblée nationale — Débat", reunions_an = "Assemblée nationale — Réunion",
      scrutins_an = "Assemblée nationale — Scrutin", legi = "Légifrance — Article de code",
      dosleg = "Sénat — Dossier législatif", dole = "DILA — Dossier législatif")
    libelle = if (source %in% names(libelles)) unname(libelles[source]) else type
    date_aff = if (grepl("^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$", date))
      format(as.Date(date), "%d/%m/%Y") else "Date non renseignée"
    if (!nzchar(titre) || identical(titre, id) || grepl("^[0-9]+$", titre)) titre = "Document"
    cat("## ", i, ". ", date_aff, " — ", libelle, " — ", titre, "\n\n", sep = "")
    cat("**Référence :** `", id, "`\n\n", sep = "")
    if ("dossier_id" %in% names(x) && nzchar(valeur(x$dossier_id)[1]))
      cat("**Dossier :** `", valeur(x$dossier_id)[1], "`\n\n", sep = "")
    url = if ("url" %in% names(x)) valeur(x$url)[1] else ""
    if (!grepl("^https://", url)) {
      if (source == "legi" && grepl("^LEGIARTI[0-9]+$", id))
        url = paste0("https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/codes/article_lc/", id)
      if (source == "amendements_an" && grepl("^AMANR[[:alnum:]]+$", id))
        url = paste0("https://www.assemblee-nationale.fr/dyn/opendata/", id, ".pdf")
      if (source == "debats_an" &&
          all(c("numero_seance_jour", "libelle_session") %in% names(x)))
        url = url_debat_an(date, valeur(x$numero_seance_jour)[1],
                           valeur(x$libelle_session)[1])
      if (source == "ameli" &&
          all(c("numero_amendement", "numero_texte", "date_texte") %in% names(x))) {
        num = valeur(x$numero_amendement)[1]
        texte = valeur(x$numero_texte)[1]
        annee = substr(valeur(x$date_texte)[1], 1, 4)
        if (grepl("^[0-9]{4}$", annee) && grepl("^[0-9]+$", texte) &&
            grepl("^(COM-)?[0-9]+", num)) {
          commission = grepl("^COM-", num)
          numero = sub("^COM-", "", num)
          numero = sub("[[:space:]].*$", "", numero)
          numero = sub("[^0-9].*$", "", numero)
          url = paste0("https://www.senat.fr/amendements/",
            if (commission) "commissions/" else "", annee, "-", annee + 1L,
            "/", texte, "/Amdt_", numero, ".html")
        }
      }
      if (source == "questions_senat" && "reference_officielle" %in% names(x)) {
        ref = valeur(x$reference_officielle)[1]
        if (grepl("^qSEQ[0-9]+$", ref))
          url = paste0("https://www.senat.fr/questions/base/", substr(date, 1, 4), "/", ref, ".html")
      }
    }
    if (grepl("^https://", url))
      cat("[Consulter le document officiel](", url, ")\n\n", sep = "")
    else cat("*Lien officiel direct non identifié.*\n\n")
    passage = extrait(x$contenu, d$sujet)
    if (nzchar(passage)) {
      cat("**Extrait**\n\n")
      cat("\\begin{shaded}\n\n")
      cat(paste0(latex_surligner(gsub("\n", " ", passage, fixed = TRUE),
        d$sujet, d$surligner), "\n\n"))
      cat("\\end{shaded}\n\n")
    }
    if (source == "questions_senat" && grepl("^[0-9]+$", id))
      cat("**Produire la fiche PDF avec parlementR :**\n\n",
          "```r\nrapport_quest_senat(\n  id = \"", id,
          "\"\n)\n```\n\n", sep = "")
    if (source == "amendements_an" && grepl("^AMANR", id))
      cat("**Produire le suivi PDF avec parlementR :**\n\n",
          "```r\nid = \"", id, "\"\n",
          "a = rech_amdt_an(\n  sujet = \"", gsub("\"", "\\\"", d$sujet), "\"\n)\n",
          "a = a[a$uid == id, , drop = FALSE]\n",
          "rapport_amdt_an(donnees = a)\n```\n\n", sep = "")
    if (source == "ameli")
      cat("**Produire le rapport PDF des amendements Sénat sur ce sujet :**\n\n",
          "```r\na = rech_amdt_senat(\n  sujet = \"", gsub("\"", "\\\"", d$sujet), "\"\n)\n",
          "rapport_amdt_senat(references = a)\n```\n\n", sep = "")
    cat("\n")
  }
  cat("## Reproduire cette recherche\n\n")
  cat("```r\nd = rech_docs(\"", gsub("\"", "\\\"", d$sujet, fixed = TRUE),
      "\", limite = 20L)\nrapport_docs(\n  references = d,\n  fichier = \"/tmp/recherche.pdf\",\n  ouvrir = TRUE\n)\n```\n", sep = "")
} else {
  textes = d$textes
  lectures = d$lectures
  amendements = d$amendements
  if (!nrow(textes)) cat("Aucun texte correspondant dans les données locales.\n\n")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(textes))) {
    x = textes[i, , drop = FALSE]
    cat("# Texte législatif\n\n")
    cols = intersect(c("intitule", "titre_complet", "numero_texte", "texte_id",
                       "date_depot", "signet", "dossier_id", "url_an"), names(x))
    for (col in cols) if (nzchar(valeur(x[[col]])[1]))
      cat("**", col, " :** ", valeur(x[[col]])[1], "\n\n", sep = "")
    if (nrow(lectures) && "dossier_id" %in% names(x)) {
      l = lectures[!is.na(lectures$dossier_id) &
        lectures$dossier_id == x$dossier_id[[1]], , drop = FALSE]
      if (nrow(l)) {
        cat("## Lectures documentées\n\n")
        cat(tableau(l[, intersect(c("commentaire", "lecture_id"), names(l)), drop = FALSE]))
      }
    }
    if (nrow(amendements)) {
      a = amendements[!is.na(amendements$texte_id) &
        amendements$texte_id == x$texte_id[[1]], , drop = FALSE]
      for (j in seq_len(nrow(a))) {
        y = a[j, , drop = FALSE]
        cat("## Amendement n° ", valeur(y$numero)[1], "\n\n", sep = "")
        for (col in intersect(c("amendement_id", "auteurs", "date_depot", "sort"), names(y)))
          cat("**", col, " :** ", valeur(y[[col]])[1], "\n\n", sep = "")
        for (col in intersect(c("objet", "dispositif"), names(y)))
          cat("### ", col, "\n\n", valeur(y[[col]])[1], "\n\n", sep = "")
      }
    }
  }
}
```
